thread:
maria gonzalez: Heads-up: saw weird divergence between console 'embed_units' and runtime 'ingress_units' during yesterday's canary, ~25% mismatch :eyes:

 tj: ugh, can you paste the query/alert?

 maria gonzalez: yeah. quick prometheus checks — console metric: `redwood_console_embeddings_units_total` vs runtime: `embed_ingress_units_total`

 maria gonzalez: query I used:
```
# console
sum(rate(redwood_console_embeddings_units_total[5m])) by (route)
# runtime
sum(rate(embed_ingress_units_total[5m])) by (route)
```

 kai: could be double-counting at the preflight layer? we recently added an ingress-middleware that records a unit estimate before splitter runs. that might show up in console pipeline and again when runtime consumes shards.

 ana: is the console pulling runtime metrics or ingesting its own counters? last I checked console ingests both but applies an alias mapping for `embed_units` -> `redwood_console_embeddings_units_total`.

 tj: timeline: canary ran 02:10-02:40 UTC, traffic burst with mixed dims. splitter created fragments and retried a few requests. retries could bump runtime counter without console dedup.

 maria gonzalez: exactly — I see retry spikes in runtime logs at 02:15. console-side telemetry shows a smaller spike because console filters retries earlier. mismatch around routes `/v1/embeddings` for tenant foo-prod.

 console-product: this is a UX/console concern too — customers see higher "units" in billing/alerts vs the runtime SLO dashboards. we need a consistent canonical metric for unit accounting and for SLOs.

 kai: proposal: add a canonical label `count_path=canonical_ingress` that runtime emits only once per logical request after dedup. console ingestion then uses that label to compute billing and SLO. fallback: keep current metrics but add a reconciliation job.

 tj: implementation notes — minimal change: in runtime, after splitter + dedup, emit `embed_ingress_units_total{count_path="canonical_ingress"}`. preflight and middleware keep their own counters but label them `count_path="preflight_estimate"`. then console query can `sum by(route) (rate(embed_ingress_units_total{count_path="canonical_ingress"}[5m]))`.

 ana: agree, but rollout plan: we need a transition window and a flag in console ingest to prefer canonical label if present, otherwise fallback to heuristics. add migration docs for API and billing teams.

 ops-bot: deployment checklist created: https://internal.redwood/infra/checklists/embed-units-canonicalization

 maria gonzalez: also add an alert to detect >10% divergence between console and canonical runtime for any route for 10m. sample promql:
```
abs(
  sum(rate(redwood_console_embeddings_units_total[5m]))
  -
  sum(rate(embed_ingress_units_total{count_path="canonical_ingress"}[5m]))
)
/
  sum(rate(embed_ingress_units_total{count_path="canonical_ingress"}[5m]))
> 0.1
```

 kai: telemetry team: we should emit a debug counter `embed_unit_id_deduped_total` to verify dedup logic during rollout. low-overhead and can be GC'd after 2 weeks.

 tj: quick follow-ups — api clients: do we need to document changed semantics? no API surface change, just server-side metric labels. but add note in release notes: "Console now uses canonical runtime units when available".

 ana: where to store the playbook for incident runbooks? suggest `docs/observability/embed-units-playbook.md` and link from console UI as "Why units can differ".

 console-product: I'll draft the UI copy and migration FAQ. will ping finance for billing reconciliation.

 maria gonzalez: ok action items: 1) kai implements canonical label + debug counter. 2) tj adds alert to alerting repo. 3) ana updates console ingest fallback + docs. 4) console-product coordinates customer comms. I'll run verification during next canary.

 tj: thx all. tagging @kai and @ana for infra work.

 kai: started a draft PR: https://git.internal.redwood/r/runtime/pull/2487 — includes metrics, tests and a small integration with splitter.

 ana: added ingest toggle in console: `prefer_canonical_units` behind feature flag. will enable in canary tomorrow.

 maria gonzalez: perfect. will monitor and report back. :thumbsup:
